_about: Guided gesture captures for recalibration (HUD ui/GestureCapture.tsx, core irene/calibration.py). Each step is recorded after a hand is in view and a countdown; a take with a hand in under minHandShare of its frames is redone. hold = keep a pose; motion = one movement per rep. Frames land in core/calibration/<profile>-<session>.jsonl with the raw landmarks, so the gesture engine can be replayed offline. One file per run: a profile never overwrites an earlier run of itself, so captures accumulate. The zoom capture is one profile per distance (zoom_panel = where he actually sits to use the second screen, ctrl+alt+shift+8; zoom_near ~0.7 m, zoom_mid ~1 m, zoom_far ~1.3 m), about three minutes each and run separately; the distance is the profile's, so the step labels inside them are plain. calibration.load_family('zoom') merges whichever have been run, every frame tagged with the session and the distance it came from. Near and mid each carry the whole confuser set between them AND the scroll pose, because a classifier that has never seen the two-finger scroll pose latches zoom on it and kills scrolling - no confuser may live only in a profile that is not run. zoom_far is optional: worth capturing if zooming at arm's length ever matters, but nothing depends on it. The keiko profiles (keiko_near, keiko_mid) record the UPPER BODY instead of a hand - 33 pose landmarks as 'pose': [x, y, z, visibility, ...] - because kamae and the three strikes are where the arms are relative to the shoulders, which a hand landmarker cannot see. 'tracks': 'pose' is what arms the pose model for that run. zoom_panel carries the whole confuser set on its own, plus the two that only happen at the panel (still_open: an open, unspread hand held still; pointer_moving: pointing and sweeping the cursor) - a still hand there latched zoom live. Record it twice: the later session is held out to test the retrain (scripts/zoom_eval.py), and it ships only if it beats the live model on that session. keiko_strikes (ctrl+alt+shift+9) is the strike recogniser's capture (core/scripts/strike_train.py): the three strikes at real speed (pace natural: GO, never SLOWLY) in 4-second takes - on the first keiko capture several strikes landed in the last few frames of a 3-second take - and every strike-shaped movement that is NOT one of them (a raise that stops, seme, a right dou, tsuki, harai, a block, rei, sonkyo) plus everyday ones. Record it twice, on different days: the newer session is held out, and the model ships only if every held-out confuser stays silent.

rps._about: Rock-paper-scissors, captured by CORE as the game itself (say 'train rock paper scissors'): she asks for a throw, counts 'rock... paper... scissors... shoot!' with the game's own clip, and the HUD's game-mode buffer sends the frames from 600 ms before to 1400 ms after the shoot instant, each with t relative to it. Same count, same timing as a real round, so the window the trainer picks is the window the game reads. core/scripts/rps_train.py; the newest session is held out.

steps.spoken: Throw rock.

steps.label: paper

steps.label: scissors

steps.label: parallel
steps.spoken: Hold up two fingers, side by side. Not crossed.

steps.label: crossed
steps.spoken: Now cross those two fingers, and hold.

steps.label: spread
steps.prompt: PANEL DISTANCE - HOLD: HAND SPREAD WIDE
steps.spoken: Zoom capture, at the panel. Sit exactly where you sit when you use the second screen, and keep your hand where it goes when you reach for it. Spread your hand wide and hold.

steps.label: fist
steps.spoken: Now a fist, and hold it.

steps.label: zoom_in
steps.prompt: PANEL - ZOOM IN: FIST TO SPREAD
steps.spoken: Zoom in, normal speed. Fist, then open it smoothly into a wide spread. Four times.

steps.label: zoom_in_fast
steps.spoken: Quick ones. Fist, snap open. Five times.

steps.label: zoom_out
steps.prompt: PANEL - ZOOM OUT: SPREAD TO FIST
steps.spoken: Zoom out, normal speed. Spread wide, then close it smoothly into a fist. Four times.

steps.label: zoom_out_fast
steps.spoken: Quick ones. Spread, snap shut. Five times.

steps.label: relaxed
steps.spoken: Now the ones that must never zoom - this is where it went wrong. A relaxed, natural hand, held still, like you're reading the panel.

steps.label: still_open
steps.prompt: PANEL - CONFUSER: OPEN HAND, STILL (NOT SPREAD)
steps.spoken: An open hand, fingers loosely together - not spread - held still in front of the panel. Like you're about to reach for it.

steps.label: pointing
steps.prompt: PANEL - CONFUSER: POINT AND HOLD (A DWELL CLICK)
steps.spoken: Point at a card on the panel and hold still, the way you'd dwell to click it.

steps.label: pointer_moving
steps.prompt: PANEL - CONFUSER: POINT AND SWEEP ACROSS THE PANEL
steps.spoken: Point, and move the cursor around the panel - card to card, top to bottom. Twice.

steps.label: scroll_pose
steps.spoken: Two fingers up together - the scroll pose. Hold it.

steps.label: waving
steps.spoken: Wave at me, like you're saying hello. Twice.

steps.label: scratching
steps.spoken: And scratch your face - cheek, nose, chin.

zoom_panel.done: Panel distance done. Run it once more for a second session - that one gets held out to test the retrain.

steps.label: spread
steps.prompt: NEAR (~0.7 m) - HOLD: HAND SPREAD WIDE
steps.spoken: Zoom capture, near. Sit about seventy centimetres from the camera, arm comfortably bent. Spread your hand wide, all five fingers apart, and hold.

steps.label: fist
steps.spoken: Now make a fist, and hold it.

steps.label: zoom_in
steps.prompt: NEAR - ZOOM IN: FIST TO SPREAD
steps.spoken: Zoom in, normal speed. Start from a fist, and on go, open it smoothly into a wide spread. Five times.

steps.label: zoom_in_fast
steps.spoken: Same again, but quick. Fist, then snap it open. Five times.

steps.label: zoom_out
steps.prompt: NEAR - ZOOM OUT: SPREAD TO FIST
steps.spoken: Zoom out, normal speed. Start spread wide, and on go, close it smoothly into a fist. Five times.

steps.label: zoom_out_fast
steps.spoken: Same again, quick. Spread, then snap it shut. Five times.

steps.label: relaxed
steps.spoken: Now three that must never zoom. A relaxed, natural hand - no gesture at all.

steps.label: scroll_pose
steps.spoken: Now two fingers up together - the scroll pose. Hold it.

steps.label: waving
steps.spoken: And wave at me, like you're saying hello. Keep waving until I say stop. Three times.

zoom_near.done: Near done. Run ctrl alt two for the middle distance.

steps.label: fist

steps.label: zoom_in
steps.prompt: MID - ZOOM IN: FIST TO SPREAD

steps.label: pointing

steps.label: scroll_pose

steps.label: scratching

zoom_mid.done: Middle done. That's both distances - the zoom capture is complete.

steps.label: spread
steps.prompt: FAR (~1.3 m) - HOLD: HAND SPREAD WIDE
steps.spoken: Zoom capture, far. Lean right back, about a metre and a third from the camera. Spread your hand wide and hold.

steps.label: fist
steps.spoken: Now make a fist, and hold it.

steps.label: zoom_in
steps.prompt: FAR - ZOOM IN: FIST TO SPREAD

steps.label: zoom_out
steps.prompt: FAR - ZOOM OUT: SPREAD TO FIST
steps.spoken: Zoom out, normal speed. Spread wide, then close it smoothly into a fist. Five times.

steps.label: waving

steps.label: scratching

zoom_far.done: That's all three distances. Zoom capture complete.

steps.label: kamae
steps.prompt: NEAR (~1 m) - HOLD: CHUDAN NO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Keiko capture, near. Stand about a metre from the camera, head and both shoulders in frame, shinai in hand. Take chudan no kamae: both hands together on the tsuka, arms forward at about chest height, shoulders square to me. Hold it.

steps.label: men
steps.spoken: Now men. From kamae, raise and cut straight down to my head. Five times, back to kamae between each.

steps.label: kote
steps.spoken: Kote. Cut down onto my right wrist - shorter, lower than men. Five times.

steps.label: gyaku_dou
steps.spoken: Gyaku-dou. Cut diagonally down across to my left side. Five times.

steps.label: shizentai
steps.spoken: Now the ones that must never be read as kendo. Just stand naturally, arms down, shinai at your side.

steps.label: arms_up
steps.prompt: NEAR (~1 m) - CONFUSER: ARMS RAISED, NO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Raise both arms in front of you, but apart - hands nowhere near each other. Hold it.

steps.label: reaching
steps.prompt: NEAR (~1 m) - CONFUSER: REACHING FOR SOMETHING
steps.spoken: Reach out for something and bring it back - a mug, the keyboard, whatever. Three times.

steps.label: scratching
steps.prompt: NEAR (~1 m) - CONFUSER: SCRATCHING YOUR HEAD
steps.spoken: And scratch your head - the one that looks most like a men strike on the way up. Three times.

steps.label: stretching
steps.spoken: Last one. Stretch your arms up over your head and down again. Three times.

keiko_near.done: Near done. Run ctrl alt five for the far one.

steps.label: kamae
steps.prompt: MID (~1.6 m) - HOLD: CHUDAN NO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Keiko capture, further back. Step to about a metre and a half so I can see you swing, head and shoulders still in frame. Take chudan no kamae: both hands together on the tsuka, arms forward at about chest height, shoulders square to me. Hold it.

steps.label: men
steps.spoken: Now men. From kamae, raise and cut straight down to my head. Five times, back to kamae between each.

steps.label: kote
steps.spoken: Kote. Cut down onto my right wrist - shorter, lower than men. Five times.

steps.label: gyaku_dou

steps.label: shizentai
steps.spoken: Now the ones that must never be read as kendo. Just stand naturally, arms down, shinai at your side.

steps.label: arms_up

steps.label: reaching

steps.label: scratching

keiko_mid.done: That's both distances. Keiko capture complete.

keiko_kamae.done: Kamae done. Now ctrl alt shift seven for the everyday movements - that one matters most.

steps.label: kamae_near
steps.spoken: Kamae capture. Shinai in both hands. Stand about a metre away, head and shoulders in frame, and take chudan no kamae, tip pointed at me. Hold it steady.

steps.label: kamae_mid
steps.prompt: KAMAE - STEP BACK TO ABOUT 1.5 M - HOLD
steps.spoken: Step back half a metre. Same kamae, tip at me. Hold.

steps.label: kamae_turned_left
steps.prompt: KAMAE - BODY TURNED A LITTLE LEFT
steps.spoken: Turn your body a little to your left, tip still at me. Hold.

steps.label: kamae_turned_right
steps.prompt: KAMAE - BODY TURNED A LITTLE RIGHT
steps.spoken: Now a little to your right, tip still at me. Hold.

steps.label: kamae_high
steps.prompt: KAMAE - TIP A LITTLE HIGHER (AT MY EYES)
steps.spoken: Raise the tip a little, to my eyes. Hold.

steps.label: kamae_low
steps.prompt: KAMAE - TIP A LITTLE LOWER (AT MY THROAT)
steps.spoken: Lower it a little, to my throat. Hold.

steps.label: into_kamae
steps.prompt: FROM SHINAI AT YOUR SIDE, RAISE INTO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Shinai down at your side. When I say go, raise it into kamae and hold. Four times.
steps.repSpoken: Down to your side. And again.

steps.label: kamae_again
steps.spoken: Last one. Kamae, as you really would against an opponent. Hold it.

steps.label: clapping

steps.label: shinai_resting

steps.spoken: Pick it up in one hand and move it, as if carrying it to the dojo.

steps.label: bowing

steps.label: standing_natural

steps.label: kamae

steps.label: men
steps.prompt: ONE MEN, THEN BACK TO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Men strikes now. On GO, one full men - big swing, kiai if you like - then back to kamae. Eight of them.

steps.label: kote
steps.prompt: ONE KOTE, THEN BACK TO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Kote now. On GO, one kote, then back to kamae. Eight.

steps.label: gyaku_dou
steps.prompt: ONE GYAKU-DOU, THEN BACK TO KAMAE
steps.spoken: Gyaku-dou: on GO, one strike to the left do, then back to kamae. Eight.

steps.label: men_small
steps.spoken: Small men now - a quick, short men, then back. Five.

steps.label: kote_small
steps.spoken: Small, fast kote. Five.

steps.label: gyaku_dou_fast
steps.spoken: Gyaku-dou as fast as you'd really hit it. Five.

steps.label: furikaburi_stop
steps.spoken: Now the tricky ones. Raise the shinai like a men - and stop. Don't strike. Then back to kamae.

steps.label: seme
steps.spoken: Seme: press in with the tip, feint, move it around - but no strike.

steps.label: dou_right
steps.spoken: A normal dou, to my right side - not gyaku. Four.

steps.label: tsuki
steps.spoken: Tsuki - a thrust to the throat. Gently! Three.

steps.label: harai
steps.spoken: Harai: sweep an imaginary shinai aside, no strike after. Four.

steps.label: block
steps.spoken: Now block - raise the shinai to take a men on it. Four.

steps.label: hiki_waza_step
steps.spoken: Step back and lower the shinai, like after the bout. Three.

steps.label: rei
steps.spoken: A standing bow, shinai at your side. Three.

steps.label: sonkyo
steps.spoken: Sonkyo - crouch, then rise into kamae. Three.

steps.label: adjust_men
steps.spoken: Adjust your men, your kote, or wipe your face. Three.

steps.label: shinai_rest
steps.spoken: Rest - shinai down at your side, just standing.

steps.label: stretching
steps.spoken: Stretch your arms over your head. Three.

steps.label: reaching
steps.spoken: Reach for something on the desk. Three.

steps.label: waving
steps.spoken: Wave at me. Three.

steps.label: drinking
steps.spoken: Take a drink of water. Three.

steps.label: talking
steps.spoken: Talk with your hands for a few seconds.

steps.label: walk_past
steps.spoken: Walk across in front of me. Two.

steps.label: kamae_again
steps.spoken: Last one: kamae again, and hold it.

keiko_strikes.done: Keiko strikes done. Record this twice, on different days - the second session is held out to test - then run strike_train.py.

hits._about: A MEASUREMENT capture of the desk, not training data: nothing trains on it. The strike event is a tuned threshold calibrated with three swings (core/irene/strike_tuning.py, config/strike_event.json) - the learned approach failed to fit its own training takes (docs/gestures.md). What this capture still gives: core/scripts/hits_diagnose.py reads what the camera sees of him at the desk - body found, wrists out of frame, blur, occlusion, dropped frames, exposure - and the framing check holds it until his hands are in the picture. Seated chisai men, three per strike take, then every fast desk movement that is not one.
hits._diagnosticOnly: Sessions recorded wrong (framed out), with why: hits_diagnose.py labels them. Nothing trains on any hits session now.

diagnosticOnly.2026-10-17T23-21-11: his wrists were below the bottom edge of the frame in 34% of strike frames (up to 1.07 of frame height), so those wrist positions are the pose model's guesses at ~0.60 visibility - recaptured with the camera tilted down

hits._framing: Before the first step, he takes kamae and the run waits until the lower of his wrists is at most wristMaxY of the frame height (0 top, 1 bottom edge). Measured on 2026-10-18: a strike's lowest point sat 0.09 below his kamae (kamae median 0.98, strikes up to 1.07), so 0.85 in kamae keeps a strike's lowest point near 0.94 - inside. Nothing is recorded while it waits.

framing.spoken: Hit capture. Sit where you hit me from when I'm studying, and take kamae. First I'm checking your hands are in the picture - tilt the camera down until it says in frame.

steps.label: seated
steps.prompt: SIT AT THE DESK, SHINAI IN HAND, STILL
steps.spoken: In frame. Now sit still for a moment, shinai in hand - head, both shoulders and both hands in view the whole time.

steps.label: kamae
steps.spoken: Take kamae at me, seated, and hold it.

steps.label: men
steps.spoken: Now chisai men, three per take. On GO, from kamae: three small fast men at me, one after another - short, sharp stop, arms only, back to kamae between each. Eight takes.

steps.label: men_stop
steps.spoken: Now the ones that must never count. Start a men like you mean it - and stop before it comes down. Three.

steps.label: punch
steps.spoken: A punch straight at the screen - gently. Two.

steps.label: reach_screen
steps.prompt: REACH OUT AND TOUCH THE SCREEN
steps.spoken: Reach out toward the screen like you're touching something on it. Two.

steps.label: lean_in
steps.prompt: LEAN IN TO READ, THEN BACK
steps.spoken: Lean in to read something small on the screen, then sit back.

steps.label: mouse

steps.label: typing

steps.label: drink

steps.label: talking

steps.label: stretch

steps.label: scratch_head
steps.spoken: Scratch your head.

steps.label: wave
steps.spoken: Wave at me.

steps.label: point
steps.spoken: Point at something on the screen.

steps.label: phone
steps.prompt: PICK UP YOUR PHONE, LOOK, PUT IT DOWN
steps.spoken: Pick up your phone, glance at it, put it down.

steps.label: shinai_desk
steps.prompt: PUT THE SHINAI DOWN, PICK IT UP
steps.spoken: Lay the shinai on the desk and pick it back up.

hits.done: Hit capture done. Run hits diagnose to see what the camera saw.
